snippet.title: What If You Took Off Your Helmet in Space? 🧑‍🚀 15 Seconds
snippet.description:
You just took off your helmet in space. You have about 15 seconds before the lights go out… but the real twist is what happens next. 🧑‍🚀

Would you rather spend 15 seconds in space without a helmet, or 15 minutes stuck in an elevator with your boss? Tell us in the comments 👇
